title.narrative: WFP - Improving Local Food Systems in East Africa 2025-2027

description.narrative: The overall project aims to drive improvement of Rwandan, Kenyan and Ugandan food systems around schools by scaling up climate-smart, sustainable and inclusive Home-Grown School Feeding (HGSF) programmes, with the objective of supporting nutrition and educational outcomes for children, as well as sustainable local production and opportunities for cleaner cooking technologies and practices in climate vulnerable countries. In Kenya, specifically the refugee and host community populations in Turkana County, has been added due to synergies with the existing programme ‘the Alliance for Inclusive Refugee Response’ (of which three of four parties are included). The project is centred around the roll out of a holistic and tailor-made solution to improve local food systems.
